body:
A `TypeError` is raised when comparing ndarrays with unsupported dtypes for comparison which is inconsistent with NumPy.

```bash
In [7]: numpy.array([1]) == None
Out[7]: array([False])

In [8]: cupy.array([1]) == None
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
TypeError                                 Traceback (most recent call last)
<ipython-input-8-0e157d55df3d> in <module>()
----> 1 cupy.array([1]) == None
cupy/core/core.pyx in cupy.core.core.ndarray.__richcmp__()
cupy/core/_kernel.pyx in cupy.core._kernel.ufunc.__call__()
cupy/core/_kernel.pyx in cupy.core._kernel._preprocess_args()
TypeError: Unsupported type <class 'NoneType'>
```
title: `__eq__` to does not handle common non-ndarray types
